top_signals.title: Warsh Speech Doesn't Change View: Von Rotberg
top_signals.summary: Wolf von Rotberg, equity strategist at J Safra Sarasin, joins Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden on "Bloomberg Daybreak Europe" to discuss his thoughts on US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's speech Friday at Jackson Hole and shares the speech did not change the firm's outlook for US equities because it was already positioned for September & December rate hikes.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.

top_signals.title: Commission sends Statement of Objections over proposed joint venture between UPM and Sappi
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Aug 2026 The European Commission has informed UPM-Kymmene Corporation ('UPM') and Sappi Limited ('Sappi') of its preliminary view that its proposed joint venture may restrict competition in the markets for different types of communication paper, which is used for printed materials, such as magazines or books.

top_signals.title: U.S., Japan, South Korea maritime drills are ‘threat’ to North Korea, Pyongyang says
top_signals.summary: The exercises and North Korea's opposition to them come as U.S. President Donald Trump has pushed for a new meeting with Kim Jong Un.
